title: The 38 leftover test Pencils leave the owner's Space, and a Pencil whose dates have all passed folds out of the live Plans

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25 in production: 38 of the 39 live Plans on /spaces/danieltyack are titled 'Browser pencil <timestamp>-<id>', dated Sep 22 to 24. They come from test/e2e/operator-calendar.spec.ts run against production in September; its afterEach cleanup (HYG-120) archives through the UI and missed these, likely runs from before the cleanup or ones that failed mid-test. None carries hold_until, so the hold sweep would never clear them. They fill the rail's Plans list, the Plans views and Work's Live Plans. Fix: the 38 test Plans are archived (reversible: archived_at), and a pure past-Pencil check folds any Pencil whose every date has passed out of Work and the Plans views.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once Work and the Plans views fold past Pencils.
